leo_cs: kickoff: Cedar Analytics dedicated pool bring-up. customer asked for guaranteed 500 qps steady, 2k qps 4m bursts, daily 15m sustained peak. need quota stamp, autoscale policy, and a 2-hr smoke + 20m progressive canary.

sana_eng: noted. serving model: rw-medium-4k, common sequence lengths median 150, 95th ~1100. plan fp16 primary + int8 fallback.

ben_sre: autoscale proposal: target_util 68%, scale_up at 72% sustained 90s, scale_down at 33% sustained 5m, max_nodes from quota. p95 latency SLO target 300ms. set downscale cooldown 6m. will enable conservative headroom during first day.

rachel_devex: loadgen snippet (will run from sandbox harness):
`baseline: 500rps x 30m; spike: 2000rps x 4m; endurance: 600rps x 15m; concurrency:100; auth: Bearer $LG_TOKEN`

rachel_devex: will also run KV prefix priming (10k small requests) 20m before canary. I'll upload logs to s3://redwood-loads/cedar/bringup for postmortem.

harry_billing: billing: reserved commit approved. invoice anchor set; flagged custom calendar request on account ACCT-7892 (renewal risk: medium due to custom terms).

infra-bot: reserved-pool created: rp-cedar-2024 id=rp-c9b8f; region=us-east-1.

sana_eng: warmup plan: run `prime-kv.sh` (gist posted) 30m pre-canary, preload embeddings cache, run light inference pass to populate KV. will share script by EOD Fri.

ben_sre: tracing note: ensure x-rw-id and x-client are propagated for each request. I'll prepare a dashboard and mute noisy infra alerts for the controlled windows.

leo_cs: proposed timeline:
- Thu 2024-10-03 15:00 UTC: billing + security handoff (harry + leo)
- Fri 2024-10-04 02:00 UTC: infra provisioning
- Fri 2024-10-04 04:00 UTC: warmup + priming (eng)
- Fri 2024-10-04 06:00 UTC: smoke + 20m progressive canary -> ramp to full over 25m

rachel_devex: will dry-run loadgen Sat 09:00 UTC. will seed sample prompts and randomize payloads to mimic customer distribution.

sana_eng: fallback routing policy: if p95 > 450ms for >2m or error_rate > 0.8% then route 30% to int8 variant as cost fallback.

harry_billing: :thumbsup: billing anchor done.

ben_sre: :thumbsup: prepping tracing and mute windows.

rachel_devex: :thumbsup: load harness ready; logs path set.

leo_cs: please react with :thumbsup: when you complete your checklist items. capture customer feedback in ticket CS-4820 and we'll run a 30m retro next day. closing thread unless blockers appear.
